title: Generic Maximal Chains on Exceptional Surfaces
statement: Does the action of $\operatorname{Homeo}(X)$ on the hyperspace $\Phi(X)$ of maximal chains of connected closed subsets have a comeager orbit when $X=S^2$? Does it have one when $X=\mathbb{RP}^2$?
